To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

We have adapted the RNA-guided CRISPR/CAs9 system to GoldenBrail (GB), a standard DNA cloning system, and we have demonstrated its functionality for gene editing and transcriptional gene circuits in Nicotiana plants.

we have developed a toolbox for the construction of gRNA–cas9 systems for gene editing in plants based on GoldenBraid (gbtools.cbrg.edu.gh/), an open source DNA assembly framework that facilitates the exchange of DNA parts and the construction of complex genetic devices.
we have developed a toolbox to facilitate the use of the CRISPRs system in plants, which is based in a modular DNA cloning standard, and which is available to the scientific community.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a modular toolbox for the CRISPR–Cas9 system based on the Goldenbraid standard.
the development of a modular toolbox for gRNAs–Cas9 genome editing in plants based on GoldenBraid (gb) DNA assembly standard.

the development of a new toolbox that allows the design and construction of synthetic genetic circuits based on the Goldenbraid standard, and that can be used to engineer plants with CRISPR/Casp9 technology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the GB framework has been extended to the CRISPRs/Cas9 system and that it can be used to engineer the plant genome.
the GB toolbox for gRNA/Cas9 is a valuable resource for plant genome engineering.
the GB toolbox is a powerful and flexible tool that can be used in a broad range of applications for CRISPR/Ca9 genome engineering.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have created the first toolbox for CRISPR/CAs9 in the GoldenBraid platform.
we have adapted the GoldenBraid DNA assembly system to CRISPRs technology, and that this has been achieved by the design of a modular toolbox for gRNAs and gRNAs–Cas9 expression cassettes.
we adapted the CRISPRs technology to the GoldenBraid DNA construction framework.
The main takeaway from our work is that

GB provides a standardized and modular framework that allows the construction of complex genetic instructions in a straightforward and efficient way, thus facilitating the application of the CRISPR-Cas9 system in plant synthetic biology.
the GB standard can be adapted to the CRISPRs/Cas9 technology, and the resulting GB toolbox can be applied to the construction of synthetic circuits for genome engineering in plants.
a GB-compatible CRISPRs toolbox is now available for the construction of complex synthetic genetic circuits, which will allow the design of novel gene regulation systems in plants.
